name: ESA Celeste (LEO-PNT demonstration), public claims
note: Only claims quoted from public pages, read on the date given. Values the pages do not state are not here.

claims.subject: Celeste
claims.claim: the demonstration fleet is 11 satellites and one spare

claims.subject: Celeste
claims.claim: the orbit is quasi polar, between 500 and 600 km
claims.quote: Quasi polar orbit, between 500 and 600 km.

claims.subject: Celeste IOD-1
claims.claim: IOD-1 is a 12U CubeSat of 20 kg built by GMV

claims.subject: Celeste IOD-2
claims.claim: IOD-2 is a 16U CubeSat of 30 kg built by Thales Alenia Space
claims.quote: IOD-2: 16U CubeSat, 30 kg, by Thales Alenia Space

claims.subject: Celeste IOD-2
claims.claim: IOD-2 weighs around 30 kg (the builder's press release)

claims.subject: Celeste IOD-1 and IOD-2
claims.claim: the first two satellites transmit in L and S band
claims.quote: L and S-band, from current GNSS.

claims.subject: Celeste IOD-1 and IOD-2
claims.claim: IOD-1 and IOD-2 launch on Rocket Lab's Electron
claims.quote: Rocket Lab's Electron for Celeste IOD-1 and IOD-2
